locations.title: Sleepy Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, get to exactly Round 11.
- Interact with the top of the [Clock](#loc=955173) in the Study then kill the last zombie while laying prone in the [Bed](#loc=955174) in the Director's Quarters.
- An animation will play on round flip, then crouch.
- Quickly but quietly make your way through, following the footsteps on the ground, and kill the single sleeping Armored Zombie to receive the key.
- Make it to the box at the end and interact with it to receive a variety of loot.

locations.title: Ray Gun Mark II Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, starting at Round 10, head down to the Mainframe Chamber and kill the Lab Technician, then pick up the [Floppy Disk](#loc=955554) it drops.
- Interact with the [Computer](#loc=955555) in the East Foyer and the printer next to it will print out a document.
- Interact with the document and remember the word that is all capitalized.
- Head to the [Chalkboard](#loc=955556) in the Nursery and convert the word into a four digit number code.
   - The number for each digit is equal to the amount of letters in the same group as it.
- Head down to the Service Tunnel and input the code in the keypad next to the [Locked Cell](#loc=955557).
- Defeat the HVT and grab the [Severed Arm](#loc=955558) it drops.
- Head to the Armory and use it on the hand sensor on the wall to unlock the [Ray Gun Mark II](#loc=955559).

locations.title: Ray Gun Mark II-W Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire an Empty Canister during the [Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg](#loc=955552).
- Head to Shem's Henge and place the Empty Canister into the [Canister Machine](#loc=955572).
- In the circle, abominations will spawn.
- Have the abominations shoot the three Rune Rocks with it's laser then have it dash into them:
   - [Rune Rock](#loc=955569)
   - [Rune Rock](#loc=955570)
   - [Rune Rock](#loc=955571)
- Once all three are done, an lockdown will commence. Protect the center until the lockdown completes.
- Head back to the Canister Machine and pick up the filled canister.
- Bring it to the [Ray Gun Mark II-W Workbench](#loc=955573) in the Supply Depot to craft the Ray Gun Mark II-W.

locations.title: Ray Gun Mark II-P Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire an Empty Canister during the [Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg](#loc=955552).
- Grab two reflectors found in fountains around the map:
   - [Reflector](#loc=955574)
   - [Reflector](#loc=955575)
- Destroy the [Wooden Boxes](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=wooden_box%20%26%26%20category%3A28041) found around the map. On the eighth one, a [Essence Bomb](#loc=955553) will drop.
- Bring the essence bomb to the [Pile of Rubble](#loc=955576) in the Service Tunnel to access the Serpent Mound.
- Place the canister into the [Canister Machine](#loc=955577) to spawn in a light emitting from the crystal in the center of the room.
- Place down the reflectors and turn them using a melee attack until the beam lights up one of the HVT statues.
- Melee the crystal and the HVT will spawn. Kill it.
- Do this for all three statues then grab the canister.
- Bring it to the [Ray Gun Mark II-P Workbench](#loc=955578) in the Director's Quarters to craft the Ray Gun Mark II-P.

locations.title: Ray Gun Mark II-R Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire an Empty Canister during the [Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg](#loc=955552).
- Around the map, kill four [Spore Plants](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=spore_plant%20%26%26%20category%3A28038) using either fire damage or an explosive, then pick up the seeds that they drop.
- Once you've acquired four seeds, head to the Conservatory and place the canister into the [Canister Machine](#loc=955583).
- Then, place a seed into the Planters in the area. Once placed, defend them until the plant is fully grown:
   - [Planter](#loc=955584)
   - [Planter](#loc=955585)
   - [Planter](#loc=955586)
   - [Planter](#loc=955587)
- Once all four are filled, grab the canister.
- Bring it to the [Ray Gun Mark II-R Workbench](#loc=955588) in the Garden Pond to craft the Ray Gun Mark II-R.

locations.title: Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire the [Ray Gun Mark II](#loc=955559) from completing the [Ray Gun Mark II Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=955548).
   - It can also be acquired in the Mystery Box.
- For each part of the next Easter Eggs, empty canisters will need to be acquired:
   - Destroy the [Blue Crystals](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=blue_crystal%20%26%26%20category%3A27416) around the map until one randomly drops the [Empty Canister](#loc=955562).
   - Head to the Rear Patio and throw a Kazimir grenade in front of the zombie window behind [Double Tap](#loc=947781) to pull in the [Empty Canister](#loc=955565), allowing you to grab it.
   - Head to the Mainframe Chamber and read the letter on the wall next to the [Lab Chamber](#loc=955566). Head to the [Leaking Pipes](#loc=955567) nearby and throw combat axes on the valve so that the gas heads to the correct letter. Lastly, use an explosive on the gas-filled Chamber to get the [Empty Canister](#loc=955568).
- After acquiring all three, the three different types of Ray Gun Mark IIs should now be set up:
   - [Ray Gun Mark II-W Easter Egg](#loc=955549)
   - [Ray Gun Mark II-P Easter Egg](#loc=955550)
   - [Ray Gun Mark II-R Easter Egg](#loc=955551)
- Now, three rituals will need to be completed to power the Sentinel Artifact with the three different models:
   - Ray Gun Mark II-W:
      - Head to the Banquet Hall and grab the [Sconce](#loc=955589) inside the box.
      - Head to the Grand Foyer and place it on the missing Sconce location on the west wall.
      - Complete a short game of Simon's Says to access the Distillery.
      - Head inside and interact with the [Soul Machine](#loc=955590) and kill zombies until the painting on the wall turns into a portal.
      - Head to the Study and look around for the [Bell](#loc=955591) then pick it up.
      - Bring it to the [Overlook Bar](#loc=955592) on the Overlook in the Grand Foyer and place it on top of the bar.
      - Turn a zombie friendly with the Brain Rot Ammo Mod then ring the bell.
      - Pick up the [Metal Hip Flask](#loc=955593) it places on the bar then place the flask on the pedestal inside the painting.
      - Defeat the HVT that spawns then interact with the Sentinel Artifact.
   - Ray Gun Mark II-P:
      - Head to the Banquet Hall and interact with the [Soul Machine](#loc=955594) and kill zombies until the painting on the wall turns into a portal.
      - Head inside the portal and grab the [Ritual Elixir](#loc=955595).
         - Head to three cups around the map and interact to pour the elixir inside, spawning an Disciple:
            - [Disciple Cup](#loc=955596)
            - [Disciple Cup](#loc=955597)
            - [Disciple Cup](#loc=955598)
         - Once all three Disciples have been killed, head back to the Banquet Hall and remember the three sets of numbers, in order, on the wall:
            1. [First Number Set Wall](#loc=955599)
            2. [Second Number Set Wall](#loc=955600)
            3. [Third Number Set Wall](#loc=955601)
         - Head to the Safe in the Western Hallways and open it using the code to acquire the [Antler Carving](#loc=955602).
         - Head into the painting and place the Antler Carving onto the pedestal.
         - Defeat the HVT that spawns then interact with the Sentinel Artifact.
   - Ray Gun Mark II-R:
      - Head to the Library and interact with the [Soul Machine](#loc=955603) and kill zombies until the painting on the wall turns into a portal.
      - Around the map are three items that need to be collected, which can spawn in one of a few locations. These items can only be seen with Aether Shroud active.
         - A free Aether Shroud canister can be found around the Mainframe Chamber during this step. This will respawn every round until the step is complete.
         - Nuclear Plant ID Badge:
            - [Fireplace](#loc=955604)
            - [Fireplace](#loc=955605)
            - [Fireplace](#loc=955606)
         - Audio Log
            - [Couch](#loc=955608)
            - [Desk](#loc=955795)
         - Ledger
            - [Desk](#loc=955607)
            - [Desk](#loc=955798)
      - Head back to the library and interact with the now glowing books in the only order it will allow you to.
      - Head to the secret room that appears and grab the [Nuclear Plant Inspection Report](#loc=955609).
      - Head into the painting and place the Nuclear Plant Inspection Report onto the pedestal.
      - Defeat the HVT that spawns then interact with the Sentinel Artifact.
- Once the Sentinel Artifact is fully charged, place it onto the machine in front of S.A.M. and interact with it to start the boss fight.

locations.title: Upgrading the Marine SP Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- With the [Death Perception](#loc=947777) perk and a Rare Marine SP, head to the [Mantle Gun Holder](#loc=955804) in the Banquet Hall.
- Place the Marine SP on the gun holder then shoot one of the two deer heads on the wall that aren't glowing.
- This will have a small particle come out that dictates which Field Upgrade to use.
- Use that field upgrade on enough zombies and all three deer heads will light up.
- An HVT will spawn nearby. Kill the HVT.
- The Marine SP on the wall should now be Epic Rarity.
- Flip rounds to repeat this and upgrade it to Legendary.
- This can be done all the way to Pack-A-Punch Tier 3.
   - This easter egg can sometimes bug out and now allow you to place the Marine SP on the wall.

locations.title: Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, complete one of the Rituals during the [Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg](#loc=955552).
- Once one is complete, purple objects will spawn around the map:
   - [Picture Frame](#loc=955810)
   - [Dirty Laundry](#loc=955806)
   - [Book](#loc=955808)
   - [Basketball](#loc=955809)
- Shoot each object to destroy it.
- As you progress, the objects will fly around. Shoot the objects orbiting it to be able to damage the main object.
   - The step will fail if it takes too long. Flip rounds to respawn the object.
- Once all four are done, head down the [Ascender](#loc=947797) and look up, then shoot the purple orb flying around to get the Wunderwaffe DG-2.

locations.title: S.A.M. Trap Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, interact with the [Computer](#loc=955812) in the Security Overlook.
- Then, on the same round, interact with one of the three computers around the map:
   - [Computer](#loc=955813)
   - [Computer](#loc=955814)
   - [Computer](#loc=955815)
- Flip the round, then one of the computers should turn red.
   - If the computer doesn't turn red, it is the wrong computer, and you must interact with the computer in the Security Overlook again before interacting with another computer.
- Interact with the computer and a floppy disk will slide out.
- Pick up the floppy disk and head back to the computer in the Security Overlook.
- Place it inside, interact with the computer, then flip rounds.
- Interact with it again then flip round another time.
- Interact with it a final time to initialize the trap.
   - This can be done once per round.

locations.title: Tiny Vermin Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to the Supply Depot and pick up the [Vermin Body](#loc=955816).
- Place it on the [Tray](#loc=955818) in the Mainframe Chamber, then head to the staircases in the Chamber.
- Behind the zombie windows are two [Warning Signs](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=warning_sign%20%26%26%20category%3A27416). Note down the colors and how many drops they have.
- Head back to the Tray and shoot the bottles on the tray in order of how many drips each color had.
   - The left bottles are green. The middle bottle is pink. The right bottle is orange.
- Pick up the Vermin Body and head to one of the [Microwaves](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=microwave%20%26%26%20category%3A27416) around the map and place it in.
- The Microwave should start turning red, then interact with it to take the Vermin Body back out.
- Head back to the Mainframe Chamber and place the Vermin Body in one of the [Blood Puddles](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-shattered-veil?search=blood_puddle%20%26%26%20category%3A27416) at the staircases.
- Using the Wunderwaffe DG-2, from the [Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=955807), shoot the nearby fan to suck in the Vermin Body.
- Finally, use a Chopper Gunner scorestreak and shoot every chimney spewing out red smoke.
- Once done, Aether Crystals will start spawning around the map and a fog rolls in. Destroy the crystals for a variety of loot.

locations.title: Free Random Perk Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Obtain the [Metal Hip Flask](#loc=955593) during the [Shattered Veil Main Easter Egg](#loc=955552).
- Head back to the Bell on the [Overlook Bar](#loc=955592) and ring it 115 times to receive a free random perk power-up.

locations.title: Friendly HVT Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map are six Mr. Peeks Parts that need to be collected:
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955830)
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955829)
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955827)
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955831)
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955832)
   - [Mr. Peeks Part](#loc=955833)
- Once all six are collected, head to the [Sandbags](#loc=955834) in the Motor Court and hold interact to rebuild Mr. Peeks.
- He'll jump inside the dog house and a friendly Vermin will come out.
- Over time, the vermin will grow into a parasite and a Doppleghast.

locations.title: Ghost Jumpscare Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire a weapon with a Thermal Scope attachment on it and progress to Round 13.
- In four windows, a ghost woman can be found while looking through the thermal scope:
   - One above West Balcony
   - One above Rear Patio
   - Two above Motor Court
   - If the ghost woman stops appearing, flip rounds.
- Stare at the ghost to make them disappear.
- After seeing the ghost woman four times, head to the South West Balcony to find the ghost woman above in a window a final time.
- Finally, head to the Nursery and interact with the [Mirror](#loc=955837) to receive the jumpscare.
- Interact with it again to gather a set of loot.
